text: Female students who have passed Class 12 with 60% or above and willing to enroll to professional engineering graduation course Must have secured a good rank in the Common Entrance Test (state-level or equivalent) Annual family income should be less than ₹ 1,00,000 Priority to students from marginalized communities Students from other states willing to opt admission at colleges in Karnataka or Kerala Each selected student will receive: Up to ₹1,25,000 per year for: Tuition Fees, Hostel Fees, Laptop Purchase & Other Approved Educational Expenses Access to two IEEE Blended Learning Platform (BLP) Technical Courses 10–12 Learning & Mentorship Sessions with Professionals from Industry & Academia Participation in IEEE Philanthropy Initiatives Placement Linkage Support & Professional Networking Opportunities Who Can Apply? Scholarship Benefits (2025 – 26) Long-term educational initiative aimed at empowering female students from low socio-income background in Karnataka and Kerala. The scholarship supports engineering education by providing financial assistance, opportunities for professional growth, and exposure to industry Empowering 20 Female Engineering Aspirants Funded by Quest Global CSR Initiatives SCHOLARSHIP (ADOPTION) 2025 - 26 IEEE India Philanthropy Click hereto apply Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Kottayam and Alappuzha Bangalore and Rural Bangalore North Karnataka: Bagalkot, Bijapur, Gadag, Dharwad, Haveri, Belagavi, Bellary, Bidar, Kalaburagi, Koppal, Raichur, Vijayanagara and Yadgir Dakshina Kannada: Mangalore, Sullia, Puttur, Ullal, Belthangady, Moodabidri, Bantwal and Kadaba Chikmagalur, Madikeri, Shimoga, Mysore, Hassan, Tumkur and Kolar Specific locations in Karnataka and Kerala SCHOLARSHIP (ADOPTION) 2025 - 26 IEEE India Philanthropy Note: Please keep recommendation letter (in IEEE format) and conduct certificate from 12th passing institution, Clearance certificate (in IEEE format) from the admitting college and all other official documents (proof of identity, proof of address, income certiﬁcate, proof of scholarship or ﬁnancial assistance letter if already received, Aadhar, PAN) ready before you ﬁll the application. Ensure that all the data ﬁlled is accurate and can be veriﬁed. Only completed applications will be accepted.
